statement: Chitra's ruling planet (Vimshottari dasha lord) is Mars; its presiding deity is Vishwakarma (the divine architect), symbolized by a bright jewel. It is traditionally associated with creativity and design, a gift for shaping something visually striking out of raw material.
editorial_note: Reflects a widely-repeated interpretation found throughout standard Vedic astrological literature, exemplified by (not claimed as a verbatim quotation of) the cited source.
